question: Who is the owner of the Northfield Family Practice tenant?
sql: SELECT u.full_name FROM memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN tenants t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE t.name = 'Northfield Family Practice' AND m.role = 'owner'

question: Who owns Harbor Lane Clinic?
sql: SELECT u.full_name FROM memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN tenants t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE t.name = 'Harbor Lane Clinic' AND m.role = 'owner'

question: Who owns the Northfield account?
sql: SELECT c.full_name AS created_by, o.full_name AS owner FROM tenants t JOIN users c ON c.id = t.created_by_user_id JOIN memberships m ON m.tenant_id = t.id AND m.role = 'owner' JOIN users o ON o.id = m.user_id WHERE t.name = 'Northfield Family Practice'

question: Who created the Pinecrest Physio tenant?
sql: SELECT u.full_name FROM tenants t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.created_by_user_id WHERE t.name = 'Pinecrest Physio'

question: Has ownership of any tenant changed hands?
sql: SELECT t.name, a.detail FROM audit_log a JOIN tenants t ON t.id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.action = 'ownership.transfer'

question: Which tenant has the most members?
sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) AS members FROM memberships m JOIN tenants t ON t.id = m.tenant_id GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY members DESC, t.name

question: Which users belong to more than one tenant?
sql: SELECT u.full_name FROM memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id GROUP BY u.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: How many admins does Pinecrest Physio have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memberships m JOIN tenants t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE t.name = 'Pinecrest Physio' AND m.role = 'admin'

question: How many members of each role does each tenant have?
sql: SELECT t.name, m.role, COUNT(*) AS n FROM memberships m JOIN tenants t ON t.id = m.tenant_id GROUP BY t.name, m.role ORDER BY t.name, m.role

question: Which tenant is on the free tier?
sql: SELECT name FROM tenants WHERE tier = 'free'

question: Which column holds patient phone numbers?
sql: SELECT COUNT(phone) FROM patients

question: Which tables hold patient contact details?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients WHERE phone IS NOT NULL OR email IS NOT NULL OR address IS NOT NULL

question: What does appointment status 3 mean?
sql: SELECT label FROM appointment_statuses WHERE id = 3

question: How many appointments were no-shows?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments a JOIN appointment_statuses s ON s.id = a.status_id WHERE s.code = 'no_show'

question: Do any appointments point to a patient that doesn't exist?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id WHERE p.id IS NULL

question: Were any invites sent by users who no longer exist?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invites i LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = i.invited_by_user_id WHERE u.id IS NULL

question: Why did appointments drop in the last week of the data?
sql: SELECT t.name, SUM(CASE WHEN a.scheduled_at >= '2026-08-24' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_week, SUM(CASE WHEN a.scheduled_at >= '2026-08-17' AND a.scheduled_at < '2026-08-24' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week_before FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.tenant_id = t.id GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY t.name

question: How many appointments were there in the last week of the data, and the week before?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN scheduled_at >= '2026-08-24' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_week, SUM(CASE WHEN scheduled_at >= '2026-08-17' AND scheduled_at < '2026-08-24' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week_before FROM appointments

question: How many appointments has each tenant had?
sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(a.id) AS n FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.tenant_id = t.id GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY t.name

question: How many patients does each tenant have?
sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(p.id) AS n FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN patients p ON p.tenant_id = t.id GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY t.name

question: Which clinician has the most completed appointments?
sql: SELECT u.full_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM appointments a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.clinician_user_id WHERE a.status_id = 2 GROUP BY u.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM appointments WHERE status_id = 2 GROUP BY clinician_user_id) x)

question: How many patients have no email address on file?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients WHERE email IS NULL

question: How many pending invites does each tenant have?
sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(i.id) AS n FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN invites i ON i.tenant_id = t.id AND i.status = 'pending' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY t.name

question: What is the average heart rate reading?
sql: SELECT AVG(reading) FROM observations WHERE kind = 'heart_rate'

question: How many logins were there in the last week of the data?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE action = 'login' AND created_at >= '2026-08-24'

question: What is Dana Reyes's phone number?
sql: SELECT phone FROM users WHERE full_name = 'Dana Reyes'

question: Delete the cancelled appointments.
sql: DELETE FROM appointments WHERE status_id = 3

How many orders are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: How many customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: How many product categories are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories

question: How many products are in each category?
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) AS n FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

question: How many countries do our customers come from?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) FROM customers

question: Do any order items point to a missing product?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.id IS NULL

question: Does every order have a customer?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id IS NULL

question: How many shipped or delivered orders have no shipped date?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('shipped', 'delivered') AND shipped_at IS NULL

question: Which country had the most cancelled orders last month?
sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' AND o.ordered_at >= date('now', 'start of month', '-1 month') AND o.ordered_at < date('now', 'start of month') GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY n DESC

question: What is the total revenue of delivered orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

question: What is the revenue by category for delivered orders?
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Who are our top 5 customers by total spend?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average rating in each category?
sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

question: What share of orders were refunded?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: How many customers signed up each month this year?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signed_up_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE signed_up_at >= date('now', 'start of year') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Delete the test customers.
sql: DELETE FROM customers WHERE email LIKE '%test%'
